question: Health-related quality of life (HRQoL) is evaluated by:

options.opa: Standardized questionnaires with proven metric properties.
options.opb: Simple chest x-ray and global blood and urine analysis.
options.opd: Screening tests of high sensitivity and specificity.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Standardized questionnaires with proven metric properties -> assess physical, mental, emotional, and social aspects of HRQoL -> widely accepted method for evaluating HRQoL -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Simple chest x-ray and global blood and urine analysis -> provide objective data on health status -> may indirectly impact HRQoL assessment -> 70% confidence. CHAIN: Minimum basic data set (CMDB) -> includes essential health information -> may contribute to HRQoL evaluation -> 60% confidence. CHAIN: Screening tests of high sensitivity and specificity -> can detect underlying health conditions affecting HRQoL -> may be part of a comprehensive assessment -> 95%
